metadata.description:
Version 1.4 is a correction-and-certificate release layered over the immutable v1.3 results companion. Its reserved release DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21712478. It preserves the proved Engine-C packet polynomials, magnitudes, and the sigma-positive Fourier convention, while adding the later provenance correction that withdraws the claim of a data-independent direct/inverse character choice in the five-control phase replay. The retained numerical statement is only that one of the two conjugate orientations has a unique quarter-turn match in each case.

The release also records the proved replacement corollary: in each of the five certified cyclic-quartic Stark cases satisfying Roblot's hypotheses (A1)--(A3), his weak solution differs from the proved Stark unit by a trivial group-ring unit, so their character coefficients have ratio in mu_4. No raw quarter-turn label is promoted without exact Artin transport.

Finally, version 1.4 adds the first fully worked nonzero imprimitive Engine-A row, RQ-000013. Exact conductor, Euler-factor, class-number, unit-norm-kernel, determinant-index, root-isolation, and Artin-action checks give E_chi=2, I_chi=2, and X_[0]=u^2, X_[1]=u^(-2). The included bnrL1 point-value comparison is explicitly quarantined and is not part of the proof.

The top-level paper differs from v1.3 only by the release-DOI update and by correcting the Tangedal--Young bibliography pagination from 1022--1045 to 1045--1061; an exact source-diff audit is included. The v1.3 supplement changes only its archive DOI. A new top-level certified addendum and deterministic correction companion contain the correction records and replay.
metadata.title: Effective Archimedean Stark Theorems over Real Quadratic Fields: Quadratic Support, Shintani Transfer, and CM Descent
